name: gnas lugs ngo sprod kyi gdams pa
item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
The second digit of the signature number is not very clear.
[S635TW6P]: 87 reports the signature "phyi ka 46," [8H6M69W4] "phyi ka 47."

On the first page on the left, drawing of a figure and various types of writing exercises in different scripts, including some statements of homage and a "ka kha ga nga | ca cha ja nya | ta tha da na |" .

On the last page: graffiti of a lama's head, a rabbit, and a horse, and an illegible inscription (writing exercise?)

Further writing exercises in the margins of fol. 2.

Only a few annotations/corrections, e.g. on fol. 12a.
